Trademark Registration — Apply Guide

• Last updated: 2026-09-15 · 3 min read
Share:
In simple words:

A trademark identifies and protects a brand feature such as a name, logo, word or symbol. Registration is applied for through the official IP India system after checking the mark and class.

S
Samjho Content Team ✓

Trusted and policy experts simplifying MSME, tax, and compliance for India. Verified by Chartered Accountants.

Simple explanation

A trademark can distinguish one business's goods or services from another's. It may be a word, logo, device, slogan or other permitted mark, subject to the applicable law and examination.

Before applying, search similar marks and choose the correct goods or services class. The application should identify the owner, mark and class accurately; a professional search can reduce avoidable objections.

Applications are examined and may be published for opposition. Registration is not instant, and the applicant must respond to examination reports or objections within the prescribed process.

Why does it matter?

A registered mark can strengthen brand protection and make it easier to act against confusingly similar use. It does not protect every unrelated product or guarantee that no dispute will arise.

Example

In numbers

A food brand can search similar marks, select the relevant class, file its word or logo application on IP India, and monitor examination and publication updates.

Types and fees

Common applications include word marks and device or logo marks. Fees depend on applicant category, number of classes and current official fee schedules, so confirm the amount on IP India before filing.

Apply online and timeline

Create an account on IP India, search existing marks, select the class, complete the application, upload the mark and owner details, pay the official fee and track status. Timeline varies because examination, objections, hearings and opposition can affect the process.

Advertisement

Important things to know

  • Search similar marks before filing.
  • Select the correct class or classes for the actual goods and services.
  • Track the application and respond to official notices on time.
  • Check current fees and forms on the official IP India portal.

Common mistakes

  • Filing without searching similar marks.
  • Choosing an incorrect class.
  • Using inconsistent owner or address details.
  • Missing an examination response or opposition deadline.

Frequently asked questions

What is a trademark?

It is a mark used to distinguish the goods or services of one business from those of others.

What can be registered?

Words, logos and other permitted marks may be registrable if they meet the legal requirements and are not barred or confusingly similar.

How much does registration cost?

The official fee depends on applicant type, classes and current fee rules. Verify it on IP India before filing.

How do I apply?

Search the mark, choose the class, complete the online IP India application, upload details and pay the official fee.

How long does it take?

There is no single guaranteed timeline. Examination, objections, hearings and opposition can extend the process.

Do I need a lawyer?

You can review the official process yourself, but professional advice may help with searches, classification and objections in complex cases.
